column1: # note: IA 1040 line 5: "Multiply line 4 by 3.8% or amount from alternate tax calculation." A flat rate, so one bracket for each filing status. Iowa prints no tax table for 2025.
# note: The form prints "00" in the cents of every entry box; the test rounds line 5 to whole dollars.
# note: The alternate tax, the low-income exemption and the tax reduction calculation (line 12) are not covered; they are in the expanded instructions, which are not vendored.
# note: Hand-transcribed from the PDF and checked against its text twice.
